Welcome to the Sub - Exameno CBE Content Generator (ECG)! This guide will walk you through the key features to help you create high-quality, curriculum-aligned educational materials efficiently.

Exameno operates on a simple pay-as-you-go credit system. There are no monthly fees; you only pay for what you generate.

How Credits Work

  • 1 Credit = 1 Document: Each time you click "Generate Content" and successfully create a document, 1 credit is deducted from your balance.
  • Failed Generations: If the system fails to generate content due to an error, no credits are deducted. Your balance is safe.
  • New Accounts: Every new account starts with 5 Free Credits to test the system.

How to Buy Credits

  1. Select Grade & Subject: Start by choosing the appropriate grade level and subject from the dropdowns. The curriculum options will update automatically.

1. Schemes of Work (SOW)

To generate a professional Scheme of Work:

  • Select Scheme of Work as the Content Type.
  • Important: You must select at least one Term (Term 1, 2, or 3) in the Topic & Source section.
  • Check "Strict Curriculum Adherence" to ensure the SOW matches the official lesson breakdown week-by-week.
  • The AI will generate a table with Weeks, Lessons, Strands, Sub-strands, Learning Outcomes, and Resources.

2. Lesson Plans

To create a specific Lesson Plan:

  • Select Lesson Plan as the Content Type.
  • Select a Term.
  • A new section called "Lesson Scheduling" will appear under the Term selector.
  • Select the Week and Lesson Number you want to teach (e.g., Week 2, Lesson 1).
  • Click "Add Lesson to Plan". You can add multiple lessons to generate a batch of plans at once.

3. Assessments (Quizzes & CBC Exams)

To create tests and quizzes:

  • Select Assessment or Quiz.
  • Go to the Question Options tab (next to Topic & Source).
  • Choose Manual distribution to set exact numbers (e.g., 10 Multiple Choice, 2 Essays) or Auto for a balanced mix.
  • You can also upload a Marking Scheme document if you want the AI to base questions on specific answers.

4. Lesson Notes

To create reading materials for teachers:

  • Select Lesson Notes.
  • Select the specific Topic/Strand from the curriculum dropdown, or type a custom topic.
  • Use the "Additional Instructions" box in the Customize tab to specify the depth (e.g., "Summarize key points for revision").

5. Record of Work Covered (ROWC)

To digitize your records:

  • Select Record of Work Covered.
  • A special form will appear. Enter the Week Range.
  • Add lesson entries. You can fill in brief details, and the AI will expand them into full professional remarks and activity descriptions.
